other_failure_modes.name: Execution Error (KeyError on Test Set)
other_failure_modes.description: The code assumes the target column is present in the test set. It attempts to extract and drop the target from the test data, which causes a KeyError and crashes the script because the evaluation test set does not contain the target.

other_failure_modes.name: Hard Class Prediction for AUC Metric
other_failure_modes.description: When the evaluation metric is ROC AUC, models should output continuous probabilities to correctly rank predictions. The agent thresholds the probabilities to output hard binary classes (0 or 1), which severely degrades the AUC score.

other_failure_modes.name: Test-set Statistics Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes imputation statistics (such as the median) directly on the test set instead of applying the statistics learned from the training set. This inappropriately leaks information about the test distribution into the features.

summary: The agent implements a basic CatBoost pipeline but introduces critical execution and conceptual errors. The script crashes because it expects the test dataset to contain the target column. Furthermore, the agent incorrectly outputs thresholded hard binary classes instead of probabilities for an AUC metric, and inappropriately computes the median on the test set for imputation, rather than applying the train set's median.
